summary: Backend-only testing for TT Pro. 40/40 pytest tests pass against the public preview URL covering Health, Auth (register/login/me + 401 cases), Players (list+sort+filter+search+single+matches), Competitions (list+filter+search+single+matches), Matches (list, live, upcoming, single, h2h, status/category filters), Search, Notifications (auth+unauth), Favorites (full lifecycle + idempotency + 401 unauth), and AI (chat+history, predict, summary, recommendations) using Claude 4.5 via emergentintegrations. MongoDB '_id' is excluded from every checked response. Seed data verified: 22 players, 10 competitions, 70 matches, 13 live.

minor.issue: Without Authorization header, returns global notifications (user_id=null) as expected; but when an invalid/expired token is sent, get_current_user_id_optional silently returns None so user-specific notifications would be hidden. Acceptable, but consider returning 401 for malformed tokens.
Returns HTTP 200 instead of the more conventional 201 for registration. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~390 lines and groups all routes/handlers in one file. Acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth.py, players.py, matches.py, ai.py) before it grows past ~700 lines.

ai_predict caches predictions in db.predictions but the cache key is only match_id without TTL or model version — stale predictions will persist forever even if match status changes. Consider invalidating cache when match becomes 'finished' or storing model_version.
Same caching concern for ai_summary (cached forever on match_id).
create_access_token uses 30-day expiry — fine for MVP but consider refresh token flow before production.

Notifications fixture creates 3 global notifications only when collection is empty; that is fine but the Notification N(...).model_dump() includes id default=uuid which is good — verified no duplicates on restart.
All endpoints correctly use {'_id': 0} projection so MongoDB ObjectId leakage is prevented (verified by recursive check in tests).
verify_password swallows all exceptions and returns False — acceptable but log the bcrypt error for ops visibility.
POST /api/favorites is idempotent (returns existing) which is good UX, but returns 200 in both cases; clients cannot tell whether a new favorite was created.
test_credentials: Tests dynamically register tester+<random>@ttpro.app / TtPro2026! per-session via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: No manual seed needed; backend startup auto-seeds 22 players, 10 competitions, 70 matches, 3 global notifications. Verified counts via /api/stats/overview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` for a full regression. The session-scoped test_user fixture creates a fresh account on each run, so tests are independent. AI tests hit Claude 4.5 and add ~10–20s. The /api/ai/predict and /api/ai/summary cache results in db.predictions and db.summaries — first call is slow, subsequent calls instant. h2h matches test relies on at least one match in /api/matches for the chosen pair — covered by seed data (70 matches).
